lines.zh: 我扭着身子在水草间穿行。
lines.en: I wriggle through the water weeds.

lines.zh: 八只眼睛一起看向左右。
lines.en: Eight eyes scan both sides at once.

lines.zh: 我贴着河底的沙滑过去。
lines.en: I glide over the riverbed sand.

lines.zh: 水流把我推得歪了一点。
lines.en: The current nudges me slightly off course.
I skirt around the sharp rock.
My tail slaps the water once.
I follow the channel downstream.

lines.zh: 光从上面照下来，很晃眼。
lines.en: Light from above is dazzling.
I squeeze through a narrow gap.
My body stretches and contracts.

lines.zh: 泥里有点动静，我过去看。
lines.en: Something stirs in the mud; I go look.
I circle the weeds twice.
Cold water over my gills feels good.
I slow down and hug the bank.

lines.zh: 我吸住一块石头，歇一会儿。
lines.en: I cling to a stone and rest a while.

lines.zh: 我游过桥下，光暗了下来。
lines.en: I swim under the bridge, and the light dims.

lines.zh: 我挂在石头上，一动不动。
lines.en: I cling to a rock, motionless.
My round mouth opens and closes.
The shadows on the riverbed are long.
Half my body is sunk in river sand.

lines.zh: 八只眼睛轮流看向四周。
lines.en: My eight eyes take turns watching.
I smell blood, far away.

lines.zh: 水流变急了，我贴紧石头。
lines.en: The current quickens; I grip the rock.
I wait for a fish to swim past.

lines.zh: 我的身体随水轻轻摆动。
lines.en: My body sways gently with the water.
A shadow passes over the water.
My mouth half opens, then shuts.
The river stones are cold as ice.
Bubbles run one by one to the surface.
I curl myself into a ring.
All eight eyes are on you.
I lift half my head from the water.
Your shadow blocks the light.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的腿绕了半周。
lines.en: I circle half around your leg.
Your hand has entered the water.

lines.zh: 我的眼全对着你的脚踝。
lines.en: Every eye is fixed on your ankle.
I do not bite; I only look.
You stand too near the water.
My mouth opens once.
You stepped back; the ripples scatter.
My body curls into a ball.
Being hauled out of the water hurts.
My mouth has let go.
I wriggle under a stone.
All eight eyes retract.
A little of my blood clouds the water.
I press to the riverbed and freeze.
That stick came down on my spine.
I thrash my tail and splash.
I am alive and can still swim.
Something is moving in the water.
That smell draws me closer.
Fish or worm? Let me smell it.

lines.zh: 我一点点蹭向你的指尖。
lines.en: I inch my way toward your fingertips.
The smell is fishy and good.
All my eight eyes brighten.
I open my mouth, then hesitate.
Just leave it there and do not move.
I circle once before daring to approach.
A thread of red spreads in the water.

lines.zh: 被撞得在水里连翻两圈。
lines.en: The hit spun me twice underwater.
Your leg brushed against my head.
I slide across your instep.
I twist once and slip away.
Water splashes all over both of us.
I passed right against you.

lines.zh: 你的靴子踩到我的尾巴。
lines.en: Your boot came down on my tail.
I swerve; the weeds scatter.
Do not stand still in the water.
I brush against you; I am very slippery.

lines.zh: 我们贴着石头并排待着。
lines.en: We rest side by side against the rock.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转，一圈又一圈。
lines.en: I circle you, round and round.
You swim slower than the water weeds.
Come with me, down to the deep.
I rest my head beside your hand.
I lend you four of my eight eyes.
Do not go; the riverbed is empty.

lines.zh: 我们藏在同一块石头下。
lines.en: We hide beneath the same stone.
I follow the ripples you leave.
Staying like this, the water feels less cold.
I pick up a small pebble in my mouth.
This thing sank to the bottom.
I flip it over with my mouth.
It moves; I put it down.
I push it into a crevice.
It is shiny; I hold it in my mouth.
I spit it out; not tasty.
This will do as a bed.
I hide it in the water weeds.
Things on the riverbed are mine.
Blood smell; I am excited now.
I open my round mouth, teeth showing.
You stepped into my stretch of water.
I speed up along the riverbed.
The target is close and warm.
I slip from your feet to behind you.
Hold still; it will be quick.
I smell the scent of your leg.
I coil my body, ready to lunge.
It is too late to run now.
I fix on that spot at your ankle.

lines.zh: 水纹把我的位置暴露了。
lines.en: The ripples give my position away.
I slow down and pretend to drift.

lines.zh: 八只眼睛各看一个方向。
lines.en: Each of my eyes watches a direction.
I wait for you to lower your hand.
The current will cover me.
I grip a stone to steady myself.
A little closer is all I need.
I do not blink; I have no eyelids.
I wait for exactly this gap.
I latch onto your calf.
My teeth grind in a ring.
I whip my head and tear.
Splashing will not get me off.
I coil around your wrist.
Blood mixes into the water.
I hold on very tight.
That bite landed well.
I lash your leg with my tail.
I let go, then bite again.
I emerge from the water weeds.
I stir up the riverbed sand.
A string of bubbles breaks the surface.
I drifted here with the current.
This stretch of water is very quiet.
I cling to the bank, waiting for you.
It is cold; I do not mind.
My head pokes out of the rock crack.
Fish pass by; I hide first.
I shake the water off my body.
Hot water makes me writhe.
I slid off the rock.
Out of water, I cannot breathe.
The blast flipped me over.

lines.zh: 一支尖物穿了我的背鳍。
lines.en: Something sharp went through my dorsal fin.
The light stings all my eyes.
I am too hungry to swim.
Lightning hit the water; I went numb.
There is no water here; it is dry.
